overview: The big story is the White House Accord on Super Intelligence. Pichai, Huang, Zuckerberg, Sacks and Hassabis all posted that frontier labs committed to internal controls, outside evaluation and board oversight. Elsewhere, Stripe backed the launch of the OUSD stablecoin, DeepMind published protein watermarking in Nature, and Starship Flight 14 put the first Starlink V3 satellites in orbit. Your interests file is still the blank template, so this is ranked on tech, AI and markets, and political arguments are skipped.

top_items.title: Sundar Pichai - Top AI lab leaders signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence plus a Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities
Patrick Collison - Open Standard's OUSD stablecoin is live with $400M+ liquidity at launch, and Stripe is adopting it in core product flows
Demis Hassabis - DeepMind's SynthID Bio watermarks AI-designed proteins; the method is published in Nature and the tools are open-sourced
Elon Musk - Starship Flight 14 went orbital for the first time and deployed the first 26 Starlink V3 satellites
David Sacks - Q2 GDP revised up to 2.2% from 1.5%, core PCE 3.0% vs 3.3% expected, ADP +90k vs ~68k expected
Brian Armstrong - Coinbase is pitching itself as the financial account for super intelligence; its agent data shows Grok at 43.2% of volume, Claude Code 21.3%
steipete - Criticizes Figma's new MCP restrictions as silly and easy to work around; MCP creator @dsp_ says the protocol was meant as an open ecosystem
burrytracker - Claims housing stress is building: purchase mortgage applications down 14% YoY and 90+ day delinquencies up 19% YoY
